# A saguaro (generated by make_env.py), 2 m.
new
material new Cactus --base-color 0.557 0.627 0.569 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Trunk --vertices 6 --radius 0.18 --depth 2.0 --location 0 0 1.0
material assign Cactus
add mesh cylinder --name ArmL0 --vertices 6 --radius 0.12 --depth 0.4 --location -0.3 0 0.9 --rotation 0 90 0
material assign Cactus
add mesh cylinder --name ArmL1 --vertices 6 --radius 0.12 --depth 0.6 --location -0.46 0 1.15
material assign Cactus
add mesh cylinder --name ArmR0 --vertices 6 --radius 0.12 --depth 0.4 --location 0.3 0 1.2 --rotation 0 90 0
material assign Cactus
add mesh cylinder --name ArmR1 --vertices 6 --radius 0.12 --depth 0.6 --location 0.46 0 1.45
material assign Cactus
select all
shade flat
export cactus.glb
